intro: Pondicherry is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. French Quarter streets on the Bay of Bengal — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Pondicherry
paragraphs: Pondicherry (Tamil Nadu) is known for its beach, heritage and food experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: About 3 hours by road from Chennai airport.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Rent a bicycle to explore White Town at an easy pace.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Pondicherry?

faq.a: About 3 hours by road from Chennai airport.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Pondicherry?
faq.a: Popular choices: White Town for heritage stays; Auroville for eco-guesthouses; Serenity Beach for surf.
